scope: Development verification only; not independent acceptance and never an implementation routing input.

primary_replay.population: All 60 unchanged published holdout questions plus all 26 original questions
primary_replay.scoring: Retain the first result of every case; factual denominator remains 48, including documented contract-admissibility caveats. Check all original 16 previously passing controls. Machine matches require subsequent full-intent and qualification review.

variability_sample.selection: Declared before final service execution; samples reused dispatch, graph construction, party composition, temporal, office and original-control paths.
variability_sample.scoring: Report repeated outcomes separately. Never replace primary-replay failures with a later success.

transfer_checks: Run all ten previously declared transfer-cases.json cases once; compare factual outputs to their pre-call direct-SPARQL evidence and preserve both negative-control refusals.
provenance: Restart only the owned non-reload loopback service at the candidate commit with the reference-date pin; record source hashes, commit and configured planner. Do not mutate or reload Fuseki.
acceptance_boundary: Independent acceptance questions/oracles were committed before any acceptance /ask call. Complete implementation and freeze the candidate before authorizing those calls; make no subsequent implementation changes against acceptance results.
